source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 9 (PDF 122-140), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Cybersecurity and Safe Digital Collaboration) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 This chapter mainly explores how technology supports:
(Yeh chapter zyada tar is baat ko dekhta hai ke technology kis cheez mein madad karti hai?)

options.text: digital duniya mein safe, secure aur zimmedarana shirkat

blocks.explanation: Introduction kehta hai ke talaba dekhenge ke technology digital duniya mein mehfooz (safe), secure aur zimmedarana shirkat mein kaise madad karti hai.

book_ref.quote: students will explore how technology supports safe, secure, and responsible participation in the digital world

blocks.prompt:
2 Practicing responsible digital behavior helps to prevent:
(Zimmedarana digital rawayya (behavior) apnane se kin cheezon se bacha ja sakta hai?)

options.text: data loss, hacking aur identity theft

blocks.explanation: Section 9.1: zimmedarana digital rawayya data loss (data ka zaya hona), hacking aur identity theft (shanakht ki chori) se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: Practicing responsible digital behavior helps prevent data loss, hacking, and identity theft.

blocks.prompt:
3 According to the chapter, how long can a computer take to crack a strong password of 12 characters?
(Chapter ke mutabiq 12 characters wala strong password tor ne (crack karne) mein computer ko kitna waqt lag sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do You Know box: 12 characters wala strong password tor ne mein laakhon saal lag sakte hain, jab ke kamzor password seconds mein toot jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A strong password with 12 characters can take millions of years for a computer to crack

blocks.prompt:
4 Online safety means:
(Online safety ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: internet istemal karte hue apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat
internet par sab ke saath files share karna

blocks.explanation: Online safety ka matlab hai internet istemal karte hue apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat karna.

book_ref.quote: Online safety means protecting yourself and your information while using the internet.

blocks.prompt:
5 Online actions leave behind ________ that can be tracked.
(Online kaam apne peeche kya chhorte hain jinhein track kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Online kaam digital footprints (digital nishanat) chhorte hain jinhein track kiya ja sakta hai, is liye share aur click karte hue ehtiyat karein.

book_ref.quote: Students learn that online actions leave digital footprints that can be tracked.

blocks.prompt:
6 Which of the following is the strongest password?
(In mein se sab se mazboot (strongest) password kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Strong password mein letters, numbers aur symbols mile hote hain aur naam ya taareekh-e-paidaish nahin hoti. Sirf T9#mk!4qZr mein teeno hain aur koi naam ya taareekh nahin.

book_ref.quote: A strong password is a combination of letters, numbers, and symbols

blocks.prompt:
7 Using a different (unique) password for each account:
(Har account ke liye alag (unique) password rakhne se kya hota hai?)

options.text: accounts ko aahista kar deta hai
hack hone ka imkaan kam karta hai
antivirus ki zaroorat khatam kar deta hai
password ko mehfooz tareeqe se share karne deta hai

blocks.explanation: Har account ka alag password hack hone ka imkaan kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Using unique passwords for different accounts reduces the chance of being hacked.

blocks.prompt:
8 In protecting important files and data online, a secure password acts as the:
(Online ahem files aur data ki hifazat mein secure password kya kirdar ada karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secure password online files aur data ki hifazat mein pehli deewar (first line of defense) hai.

book_ref.quote: A secure password acts as the first line of defense in protecting important files and data online.

blocks.prompt:
9 Which of the following is a good password habit?
(In mein se password ki achhi aadat kaun si hai?)

options.text: Har account par aik hi password
Waqtan fawaqtan badalna aur share na karna

blocks.explanation: Password waqtan fawaqtan badalna aur kisi se share na karna chahiye; birthday jaisi zaati maloomat se bachein aur har account ka alag password rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Passwords should be changed regularly and not shared with others.

blocks.prompt:
10 Programs downloaded from unknown websites are risky mainly because they may:
(Na-maloom websites se download kiye gaye programs khaas taur par kyun khatarnak hain?)

options.text: internet connection tez kar dete hain
operating system khud update kar dete hain
un mein virus ya spyware chhupa ho jo baghair ijazat data jama kare

blocks.explanation: Kuch downloads mein virus ya spyware chhupe hote hain jo ijazat ke baghair data jama karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Some downloads hide viruses or spyware that collect data without permission.

blocks.prompt:
11 Which of the following is an example of unsafe browsing?
(In mein se unsafe browsing ki misal kaun si hai?)

options.text: Download se pehle source check karna

blocks.explanation: Unsafe browsing mein jaali websites kholna ya na-maloom links par click karna shamil hai, jis se fraud ya identity theft ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Unsafe browsing, such as visiting fake websites or clicking unknown links, can also lead to scams or identity theft.

blocks.prompt:
12 Before downloading a program, a careful user should first:
(Koi program download karne se pehle mohtaat user ko pehle kya karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Download se pehle source (zariya) check karna aur extra hifazat ke liye antivirus istemal karna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: It is important to check sources before downloading and use antivirus tools for extra protection.

blocks.prompt:
13 Keeping programs and applications in good working condition by updating them regularly is called:
(Programs aur applications ko baqaidagi se update kar ke achhi halat mein rakhna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Software maintenance (dekh bhaal) ka matlab hai programs ko baqaidagi se update kar ke achhi halat mein rakhna.

book_ref.quote: Software maintenance means keeping programs and applications in good working condition by updating them regularly.

blocks.prompt:
14 Which of the following is NOT a usual result of a software update?
(In mein se kaun si cheez software update ka aam nateeja NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Updates aksar errors theek karte hain, performance behtar karte hain aur naye features dete hain; user ki files mitana un ka kaam nahin.

book_ref.quote: Updates often fix errors, improve performance, and add new features that make software safer to use.

blocks.prompt:
15 Software that is not updated becomes an easy target for hackers because older versions may have:
(Update na kiya gaya software hackers ka aasaan nishana kyun banta hai? Purane versions mein kya ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Purane versions mein security holes (hifazati suraakh) ho sakte hain jo files ya zaati data tak baghair ijazat rasai de dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Older versions may have security holes that allow unauthorized access to files or personal data.

blocks.prompt:
16 Besides security risks, outdated software can also cause:
(Security khatron ke ilawa purana software aur kya masla paida kar sakta hai?)

options.text: naye systems ya tools ke saath compatibility ke masail

blocks.explanation: Purana software naye systems ya tools ke saath compatibility (mutabiqat) ke masail bhi paida kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Outdated software can also cause compatibility issues with new systems or tools.

blocks.prompt:
17 Privacy settings can be adjusted to protect personal data such as:
(Privacy settings ko kin zaati data ki hifazat ke liye badla ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Privacy settings ko location, contacts aur browsing history jaise zaati data ki hifazat ke liye badla jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Students learn how to adjust them to protect personal data such as location, contacts, and browsing history.

blocks.prompt:
18 Managing privacy settings mainly helps to prevent:
(Privacy settings sambhalne se khaas taur par kis cheez se bachao hota hai?)

options.text: ghair-zaroori zaraye ya advertisers ka maloomat ka ghalat istemal

blocks.explanation: Privacy sambhalne se ghair-zaroori zaraye ya advertisers ke haathon maloomat ke ghalat istemal se bachao hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Managing privacy helps prevent misuse of information by unwanted sources or advertisers.

blocks.prompt:
19 On Instagram, when a user makes the account private:
(Instagram par jab user apna account private kar de to kya hota hai?)

options.text: internet par har koi posts dekh sakta hai
sirf approved followers posts dekh sakte hain
posts advertisers ko share ho jati hain

blocks.explanation: Instagram par account private karne se sirf manzoor shuda (approved) followers posts dekh sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: users can make their account private so that only approved followers can see their posts

blocks.prompt:
20 A privacy policy should be read carefully:
(Privacy policy ko ghaur se kab parhna chahiye?)

options.text: sirf account hack hone ke baad
account banane ya terms manzoor karne se pehle
kabhi nahin, yeh sirf wakeelon ke liye hai

blocks.explanation: Account banane ya terms manzoor karne se pehle privacy policy ghaur se parhna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: It is important to read them carefully before creating an account or agreeing to terms.

blocks.prompt:
21 A privacy policy tells users:
(Privacy policy users ko kya batati hai?)

options.text: un ka data kaise jama, istemal, store aur share hota hai

blocks.explanation: Privacy policy batati hai ke user ka data kaise jama, istemal, mehfooz aur share kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A privacy policy tells users how their data is collected, used, stored, and shared.

blocks.prompt:
22 Besides the type of data collected, a social platform's privacy policy may also explain whether the data is:
(Jama kiye jane wale data ki qism ke ilawa social platform ki privacy policy yeh bhi bata sakti hai ke data:)

options.text: advertisers ya third-party services ko share hota hai
user ke antivirus se encrypt hota hai

blocks.explanation: Privacy policy yeh bhi bata sakti hai ke data (naam, email, location, browsing activity, app usage) advertisers ya third-party services ko diya jata hai ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: It may also explain whether this data is shared with advertisers or third-party services.

blocks.prompt:
23 On WhatsApp, read receipts are commonly known as:
(WhatsApp par read receipts ko aam taur par kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: WhatsApp par users read receipts (blue ticks) band kar sakte hain taake doosre na dekh sakein ke message parha gaya ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: They can also disable read receipts, commonly known as blue ticks

blocks.prompt:
24 Users should regularly review and update their privacy settings because:
(Users ko apni privacy settings baqaidagi se kyun dekhni aur update karni chahiyein?)

options.text: settings aik din baad khatam ho jati hain
platforms aksar apne privacy rules badalte hain
is se internet tez hota hai
antivirus is ka taqaza karta hai

blocks.explanation: Settings baqaidagi se dekhni chahiyein kyunke platforms aksar apne privacy rules badalte rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The user should regularly review and update their settings as platforms often change their privacy rules.

blocks.prompt:
25 On WhatsApp, the choices for who can see a user's profile photo include:
(WhatsApp par profile photo kaun dekh sakta hai, is ke options kya hain?)

options.text: sirf contacts ke bahar wale log

blocks.explanation: Chapter ki misal: WhatsApp par user chun sakta hai ke profile photo kaun dekhe: everyone, sirf contacts, ya koi nahin (nobody).

book_ref.quote: users can choose who can see their profile photo, such as everyone, only contacts, or nobody

blocks.prompt:
26 In Google Docs group work, a classmate who only needs to read the document should be given which permission?
(Google Docs ke group kaam mein jis classmate ko sirf document parhna ho, use kaun si permission deni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Agar doosron ko sirf parhna ho to permission Edit ke bajaye View only rakhein; is se document ghair-zaroori tabdeeli se bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: if others only need to read the document

blocks.prompt:
27 When sharing files or communicating online with a group, it is important to:
(Group ke saath online files share karte ya baat karte hue kya zaroori hai?)

options.text: document har kisi ko share karna
koi bhi na-maloom website istemal karna
secure platforms istemal karna aur hifazati usool maanna

blocks.explanation: Online files share karte ya baat karte hue secure platforms istemal karna aur hifazati usool maanna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: It is important to use secure platforms and follow safety rules when sharing files or communicating online.

blocks.prompt:
28 Secure collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams safeguard data by using:
(Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams jaise secure platforms data ko kaise mehfooz rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh platforms encrypted communication aur access controls (rasai par pabandi) jaise features se data mehfooz rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: These platforms use features like encrypted communication and access controls to safeguard data.

blocks.prompt:
29 In a secure online class on Google Meet:
(Google Meet par secure online class mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: internet wala har koi aa sakta hai
sirf authorized log shamil ho sakte hain
kabhi koi password ya invite nahin hota
meeting public post ki jati hai

blocks.explanation: Google Meet ki secure online class mein sirf ijazat yafta (authorized) log shamil ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: where only authorized participants are allowed to join

blocks.prompt:
30 In a class group chat, which of the following is poor digital etiquette?
(Class group chat mein in mein se kaun si baat ghalat digital etiquette hai?)

options.text: Sanjeeda baat ke dauran ghair-mutaliq memes bhejna
Baat ko taleem par markooz rakhna

blocks.explanation: Class group chat mein sanjeeda taleemi baat ke dauran spam, ghair-mutaliq memes ya mazaq bhejne se bachna chahiye.

book_ref.quote: They should avoid sending spam messages, unrelated memes, or jokes during serious academic discussions.

blocks.prompt:
31 Responsible online communication helps to:
(Zimmedarana online communication kis cheez mein madad karti hai?)

options.text: team leader se zaati maloomat chhupana
teamwork aur musbat, professional digital mahol

blocks.explanation: Zimmedarana communication teamwork ko barhati hai aur musbat aur professional digital mahol banaye rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Responsible communication promotes teamwork and helps maintain a positive and professional digital environment.

blocks.prompt:
32 Cybersecurity awareness means:
(Cybersecurity awareness ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: computers, networks aur data ko hamlon se bachane ki samajh

blocks.explanation: Cybersecurity awareness ka matlab hai samajhna ke computers, networks aur data ko hamlon (attacks) se kaise bachaya jaye.

book_ref.quote: Cybersecurity awareness means understanding how to protect computers, networks, and data from attacks.

blocks.prompt:
33 Online banking should not be done on public Wi-Fi because:
(Public Wi-Fi par online banking kyun nahin karni chahiye?)

options.text: public Wi-Fi hamesha bohat aahista hota hai
public networks shayad secure na hon
bank Wi-Fi ki ijazat nahin dete
is se battery zyada kharch hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Online banking ya hassas kaam ke liye public Wi-Fi se bachein kyunke public networks shayad secure na hon.

book_ref.quote: They should also avoid using public Wi-Fi for online banking or other sensitive work because public networks may not be secure.

blocks.prompt:
34 Actions or programs that target computers and networks to cause harm are called:
(Woh actions ya programs jo nuqsan pohanchane ke liye computers aur networks ko nishana banate hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cyber threats (cyber khatre) woh actions ya programs hain jo computers aur networks ko nuqsan pohanchate hain, maslan maloomat churana ya system kharab karna.

book_ref.quote: Cyber threats are actions or programs that target computers and networks to cause harm.

blocks.prompt:
35 The first step toward protecting digital systems is:
(Digital systems ki hifazat ki taraf pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: internet hamesha ke liye band karna

blocks.explanation: Khatron ko pehchanna (recognizing threats) digital systems ki hifazat ka pehla qadam hai.

book_ref.quote: Recognizing threats is the first step toward protecting digital systems.

blocks.prompt:
36 According to the Do You Know box, which attack is among the most common?
(Do You Know box ke mutabiq kaun sa attack sab se aam hamlon mein se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do You Know box kehta hai ke phishing sab se aam hamlon mein se hai.

book_ref.quote: Phishing is among the most common attacks.

blocks.prompt:
37 The cyber threat that spreads through infected files and can damage or delete data is:
(Woh cyber threat jo infected files ke zariye phailta hai aur data kharab ya delete kar sakta hai, kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Virus infected files ke zariye phailta hai aur data kharab ya delete kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: A virus spreads through infected files and can damage or delete data.

blocks.prompt:
38 A user's files suddenly become locked and a message demands money to unlock them. This is:
(User ki files achanak lock ho jati hain aur unhein kholne ke liye paise maange jate hain. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ransomware data ko lock kar deta hai aur kholne ke liye paise maangta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ransomware locks data and demands payment to unlock it

blocks.prompt:
39 Software that secretly collects user information is called:
(Woh software jo chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spyware chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta hai.

book_ref.quote: while spyware secretly collects user information

blocks.prompt:
40 DDoS stands for:
(DDoS ka poora naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: DDoS ka matlab Distributed Denial of Service hai; yeh hamle websites par itna bojh daalte hain ke woh crash ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks overload websites, making them crash.

blocks.prompt:
41 A website suddenly crashes because it is overloaded by an attack. The attack is most likely:
(Aik website hamle ki wajah se bojh tale aa kar crash ho jati hai. Yeh ghaliban kaun sa hamla hai?)
blocks.explanation: DDoS hamle websites par bojh daal kar unhein crash kar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks overload websites, making them crash.

blocks.prompt:
42 Phishing usually works through:
(Phishing aam taur par kis zariye se kiya jata hai?)

options.text: files lock kar ke paise maangna

blocks.explanation: Phishing jaali emails ya websites ke zariye logon ko dhoka de kar passwords ya zaati maloomat hasil karne ki koshish hai.

book_ref.quote: Phishing tries to trick people into sharing passwords or personal details through fake emails or websites.

blocks.prompt:
43 Harmful software designed to damage a computer, steal data or disturb normal system operations is called:
(Woh nuqsan deh software jo computer kharab kare, data churaye ya system ka aam kaam bigaare, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Summary: malware woh nuqsan deh software hai jo computer kharab kare, data churaye ya system ka kaam bigaare.

book_ref.quote: Malware is harmful software designed to damage a computer, steal data, or disturb normal system operations.

blocks.prompt:
44 Ransomware is a type of:
(Ransomware kis cheez ki aik qism hai?)
blocks.explanation: Summary: ransomware malware ki aik qism hai jo files ya system lock kar ke rasai wapas dene ke liye paise maangta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ransomware is a type of malware that locks files or systems and demands payment to restore access.

blocks.prompt:
45 For companies, a cyberattack may lead to:
(Companies ke liye cyberattack ka kya nateeja ho sakta hai?)

options.text: data breaches aur customers ka aitmaad khatam hona

blocks.explanation: Log files, passwords ya paise kho sakte hain, jab ke companies ko data breaches aur customers ke aitmaad ke khatme ka saamna ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: while companies may face data breaches and loss of customer trust

blocks.prompt:
46 Which statement about cyberattacks is correct according to the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq cyberattacks ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Schools aur hospitals bhi mutasir ho sakte hain
Sirf banks par hamla hota hai

blocks.explanation: Hamle karobar rok sakte hain aur maali nuqsan karte hain; schools aur hospitals bhi cyber waqiaat se mutasir ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Even schools and hospitals can be affected by cyber incidents.

blocks.prompt:
47 Which of the following is NOT one of the security tools named in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa chapter mein bataya gaya security tool NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Security tools mein authentication systems, firewalls aur antivirus programs shamil hain; spreadsheet security tool nahin.

book_ref.quote: These tools include authentication systems, firewalls, and antivirus programs that check and block harmful activities.

blocks.prompt:
48 In Two-Factor Authentication, after entering the password the user usually confirms identity by:
(Two-Factor Authentication mein password ke baad user apni shanakht aam taur par kaise confirm karta hai?)

options.text: phone ya email par aaya code dal kar

blocks.explanation: 2FA mein password ke baad user ke phone ya email par aik code aata hai jis se shanakht confirm hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: after entering a password, the user may receive a code on their phone or email to confirm their identity

blocks.prompt:
49 How many forms of verification does 2FA require before allowing access to an account?
(Account tak rasai dene se pehle 2FA kitni tasdeeqat (forms of verification) maangta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Two-Factor Authentication account kholne se pehle do tasdeeqat maangta hai.

book_ref.quote: requires two forms of verification before allowing access to an account

blocks.prompt:
50 Which of the following is NOT a biometric feature?
(In mein se kaun si cheez biometric feature NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Biometric verification jismani features (fingerprints, chehra, awaaz) istemal karti hai; password jismani feature nahin.

book_ref.quote: Biometric verification uses physical features such as fingerprints, face scans, or voice patterns to verify identity.

blocks.prompt:
51 A firewall acts as a barrier between:
(Firewall kin do cheezon ke darmiyan deewar ka kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Firewall computer aur internet ke darmiyan deewar hai: mehfooz data guzarne deta hai aur nuqsan deh traffic rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: A firewall acts as a barrier between a computer and the internet

blocks.prompt:
52 The main job of an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is to:
(Intrusion Detection System (IDS) ka asal kaam kya hai?)

options.text: networks ki nigrani aur users ko khabardar karna
files lock kar ke paise maangna
data ko coded text mein badalna

blocks.explanation: IDS networks par mashkook (suspicious) sargarmiyon ki nigrani karta hai aur users ko mumkina khatron se khabardar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) monitor networks for suspicious activities and alert users about possible threats.

blocks.prompt:
53 Software that scans files and removes viruses or malware before they cause damage is:
(Woh software jo files scan kar ke virus ya malware ko nuqsan se pehle nikal deta hai, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antivirus software files scan karta hai aur virus ya malware ko nuqsan se pehle nikal deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Antivirus software scans files and removes viruses or malware before they cause damage.

blocks.prompt:
54 A firewall monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic according to:
(Firewall aane aur jane wali network traffic ko kis ke mutabiq control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Summary: firewall aane jane wali network traffic ko security rules (hifazati usoolon) ke mutabiq control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A firewall is a security tool that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic according to security rules.

blocks.prompt:
55 Keeping digital information safe from unauthorized access, loss or damage is called:
(Digital maloomat ko baghair ijazat rasai, zaya hone ya nuqsan se bachana kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data protection (data ki hifazat) digital maloomat ko baghair ijazat rasai, zaya hone ya nuqsan se bachana hai.

book_ref.quote: Data protection means keeping digital information safe from unauthorized access, loss, or damage.

blocks.prompt:
56 The science of securing information so that only authorized users can understand it is:
(Maloomat ko is tarah mehfooz karne ka ilm ke sirf authorized users samajh sakein, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cryptography maloomat ko is tarah mehfooz karne ka ilm hai ke sirf authorized users use samajh sakein.

book_ref.quote: Cryptography is the science of securing information so that only authorized users can understand it.

blocks.prompt:
57 Converting coded text back into its original readable form is called:
(Coded text ko wapas asal parhne ke qabil shakal mein badalna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Encryption parhne wale data ko coded text banata hai; decryption use wapas asal shakal mein laata hai.

book_ref.quote: while decryption converts it back into its original form when needed

blocks.prompt:
58 Encryption changes readable data into coded text by using a specific:
(Encryption parhne wale data ko kis cheez ki madad se coded text mein badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Encryption aik khaas key ki madad se parhne wale data ko coded text mein badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Encryption changes readable data into coded text using a specific key

blocks.prompt:
59 Which of the following is NOT named in the chapter as a common use of cryptography?
(In mein se kaun sa cryptography ka chapter mein bataya gaya istemal NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cryptography secure websites, online banking aur messaging apps mein aam istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Cryptography is widely used in secure websites, online banking, and messaging apps.

blocks.prompt:
60 An example of an encrypted connection that keeps information safe during transmission is:
(Bhejte waqt maloomat ko mehfooz rakhne wale encrypted connection ki misal kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Encrypted connections, jaise HTTPS, bhejte waqt maloomat ko mehfooz rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Secure methods such as encrypted connections (like HTTPS) keep information safe during transmission.

blocks.prompt:
61 Regular backups protect data from loss caused by:
(Baqaidagi se liye gaye backups data ko kis wajah se zaya hone se bachate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Baqaidagi se backups system kharabi ya hamlon se data zaya hone se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: Regular backups help protect data from loss caused by system failure or attacks.

blocks.prompt:
62 Cloud storage services prevent unauthorized access to saved files by using:
(Cloud storage services mehfooz ki gayi files tak baghair ijazat rasai ko kaise rokti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cloud storage services bhi encryption istemal karti hain taake saved files tak baghair ijazat rasai na ho.
